sentences.text: Issue notice returnable in the month of October 2023.
Notice will be served by all modes, including dasti.

The issue raised in the present matter relates to the interpretation of Section 300 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and Article 20 (2) of the Constitution of India, in view of the acquittal of the petitioners after full trial under Section 498A and 304B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
The sentence awarded to the petitioners under Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 will remain suspended till the next date of hearing.
